summary: Phase 4 — Comment likes/replies + Universal Reporting System. Backend: 31/31 pytest tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_phase4_reporting.py covering comment like toggle (200/404), threaded comments (1-level cap, replies re-parented), notifications (kind=comment / reply / comment_like), POST /api/reports universal (post-type ticket+DM, duplicate dedupe, message-privacy gate, screenshot cap at 8, non-string rejection, all 11 reasons accepted, invalid reason rejected, unknown content_type rejected), GET /api/admin/support/tickets/{id}/report (admin 200, non-admin 403, plain ticket 404, NO message body leak), atomic ticket counter monotonic under 5 back-to-back POSTs. Frontend: Feed Report button visible per post, click opens portal ReportModal containing all 11 reason buttons + description + 8-shot uploader + submit/cancel — every testid pattern from spec verified live on https://realm-deploy.preview.emergentagent.com/feed (logged in as tftwo).

integration_issues.issue: InstallPrompt overlay re-appears after the ReportModal closes (state change re-mounts the prompt despite localStorage install_prompt_dismissed='1' set earlier in session). This blocked the secondary click-to-open-PostPopup in automation. Real users would tap NOT NOW once. Recommend honouring localStorage flag on remount to prevent re-display in the same session.

action_items: (LOW) InstallPrompt re-renders after closing other modals/state changes despite localStorage 'install_prompt_dismissed' being set. Consider gating render on a useState read from localStorage on mount AND skipping subsequent shows in the same session.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/moderation.submit_report has good privacy gating: skips coll.update_one when content_type=='message', and the support-ticket preview is metadata-only (reason + target ref + screenshot count) — no message body retrieved or stored.
routers/tickets.admin_report_details NEVER fetches db.messages, so no leak path even if the screenshots/preview were tampered with.

routers/posts.comment_post correctly normalises 2-level cap: if parent.parent_id is set, parent_id := parent.parent_id (grandparent). Notifications correctly emit `reply` to the original parent author (not the reparented one) — verified via test.

routers/posts.like_comment is symmetric with /posts/{id}/like (addToSet/$pull on liked_by[], $inc on likes), and fires comment_like only on the liked→unliked transition AND only when actor != author. Good.
ReportPayload.screenshots is `Optional[list[str]]` — pydantic correctly rejects non-string items with 400/422 (verified). Cap to 8 happens before validation, which is fine.

success_rate.frontend: ReportModal portal + all 11 reasons + screenshot uploader + submit verified live; PostPopup secondary navigation blocked by InstallPrompt re-render (pre-existing dev quirk)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_phase4_reporting.py is fully pytest-compatible with conftest in place; runs in ~5s. Notification kind field is `kind` NOT `type`. Notifications endpoint is /api/notifications/list. Image upload has daily cap of 20 per 24h — don't bulk-upload in tests. Frontend uses cookie-based auth; await page.evaluate fetch('/api/auth/login',{credentials:'include'}) before goto. Install prompt re-renders even with localStorage flag — pre-dismiss before page.goto and again immediately after.
rca of the issue: No real bugs. Single pre-existing UX nit: InstallPrompt component does not respect the install_prompt_dismissed localStorage flag across re-renders in the same SPA session, so closing a different modal (e.g. ReportModal) re-shows it. Spec features all work as designed at API and UI render level.
